before: Every raised text-anchored table of one anchor kept the place its anchor had before the earlier lines moved, and legacy modes tested a line alone against a floating table band.
after: Each table of an anchor opens from the flow after the moves the tables before it caused, and legacy modes test a paragraph's last line with its space after. Shared document state and operations are unchanged.
reason: The change is confined to layout. Replicas compute the same layout from the same tree, and saved documents keep the same XML.
